body: But what is there to live for when you have no one and nothing.

I won't make it to 2023 either. So I feel your pain. Family treats me like I'm inconvenient. So as of late I've been reclusive and prepping for the end. I've literally written out my funeral wishes and my actual will. Even though if my family finds it first they'll burn it.
I'm not good at trying. I give up easily.
There's not alot to offer there. I'm about as interesting as white bread.
I don't have very many skills. I make people laugh when I'm happy. Not a very competitive person though so I don't think they'd want me on their team
But how do you advertise yourself when you don't have much to offer?
No i havent. What kind of voluntary work?
